name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network f:fake.onnx

name: Agda
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda -c Marabou.queries

name: Rocq
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v

name: RocqVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v && rocq compile -w none -vok Rocq.v

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl
